questions.question: Mock (incident): Black Friday pik paytida prod HTTP 504 Gateway Timeout qaytaryapti. Qanday triage qilasiz?
questions.explanation: ALB metrikalari: 504 — backend idle timeout ichida javob bermadi.

questions.question: Mock (incident): Kubernetes worker node'lari Ready va NotReady orasida "sakrayapti". Triage?
questions.explanation: kubectl describe node <node>: PIDPressure yoki "Kubelet stopped posting status".

questions.question: Mock (incident): thundering herd retry'lari sabab DB kaskad crash loop. Triage?
questions.explanation: DB restart bo'ladi, lekin 5000 pod darhol qayta ulanib, 10 soniyada yana yiqitadi.

questions.question: Mock (incident): Prometheus har kuni ertalab OOM bilan yiqilyapti. Triage?
questions.explanation: TSDB status API (/api/v1/status/tsdb) — eng yuqori cardinality'li metrika.

questions.question: Mock (incident): `terraform apply` dan keyin prod S3 bucket public bo'lib qoldi. Triage?
questions.explanation: Darhol cheklash: akkaunt darajasida S3 Block Public Access (aws s3control put-public-access-block).

questions.question: Mock (incident): CoreDNS OOMKilled bo'lib butun klaster bo'ylab avariya. Triage?
questions.explanation: Simptom: barcha namespace'larda DNS ishlamaydi; CoreDNS exit code 137.

questions.question: Mock (incident): container log'lari sabab node diski 100% to'ldi. Triage?
questions.explanation: Simptom: kubelet node'dagi pod'larni evict qilyapti; DiskPressure.

questions.question: Mock (incident): force push sabab `main` branch buzildi. Triage?
questions.explanation: Simptom: kimdir main ga git push --force qilib 30 ta umumiy commit'ni o'chirgan.

questions.question: Mock (incident): prod deploy paytida Terraform state lock qotib qoldi. Triage?
questions.explanation: Simptom: Error acquiring the state lock: ConditionalCheckFailedException.

questions.question: Mock (incident): prod Ingress'da SSL sertifikat muddati tugadi. Triage?
questions.explanation: Simptom: brauzerda ERR_CERT_DATE_INVALID.

questions.question: Mock (incident): AWS NAT Gateway bandwidth chegarasiga yetdi. Triage?
questions.explanation: Simptom: private subnet'dagi EC2'larda paket yo'qolishi va juda sekin yuklash.

questions.question: Mock (incident): PostgreSQL max connections'ga yetdi. Triage?
questions.explanation: Simptom: FATAL: remaining connection slots are reserved for non-superuser connections.

questions.question: Mock (incident): JVM memory leak sekin degradatsiya va CPU sakrashlariga sabab. Triage?
questions.explanation: Simptom: 24 soat ichida latency asta o'sadi; GC CPU 100% ga chiqadi.

questions.question: Mock (incident): Kafka consumer group lag millionlab xabarga sakradi. Triage?
questions.explanation: Simptom: ishlov kechikishi soatlab; kafka_consumergroup_lag o'smoqda.

questions.question: Mock (incident): unassigned shard'lar sabab Elasticsearch klaster holati RED. Triage?
questions.explanation: Simptom: qidiruvlar yiqilmoqda, health RED.

questions.question: Mock (incident): pod soatlab `Terminating` da. Triage?
questions.explanation: Simptom: kubectl delete pod cheksiz osilib turadi.

questions.question: Mock (incident): OOM killer kritik MySQL'ni o'ldiryapti. Triage?
questions.explanation: Simptom: DB log'ida xato yo'q, to'satdan to'xtaydi; dmesg -T — Out of memory: Killed process (mysqld).

questions.question: Mock (incident): BGP route flapping sabab Direct Connect vaqti-vaqti bilan uziladi. Triage?
questions.explanation: Simptom: on-prem → AWS ulanishi har 5 daqiqada uziladi.

questions.question: Mock (incident): oqib ketgan credential'lar orqali IAM role buzildi. Triage?
questions.explanation: Darhol bekor qilish: role'ga aws:TokenIssueTime sharti bilan barcha harakatlarni taqiqlovchi inline policy ("Revoke active sessions").

questions.question: Mock (incident): Ingress controller HTTP 502 Bad Gateway qaytaryapti. Triage?
questions.explanation: Diagnoz: Nginx Ingress log'i — connect() failed (111: Connection refused) while connecting to upstream.
